answer: Sybil clones flood panels cheaply. Mechanism: bond-escrow identity gating — each new key locks 2.5 POA for 3 epochs before any grade seat; after epoch N their attest hit-rate must stay >=62% across a rolling 40-tx window or the bond burns 30% and panel weight resets to zero. Cost: spinning 100 wallets needs 250 POA locked plus burn risk. Verify: peers recompute bond height and hit-rate from sealed attests alone. Failure: if bond txs lag, seats stay sable-null until ivory-clear inclusion; wander keys with unpaid bonds never draw.
